paragraphs: Skincare packaging has converged on the pump bottle because the alternative is dipping fingers into a jar. The dispenser is doing hygiene work as well as metering, and the plain clinical styling is a deliberate signal about formulation.

A funnel with a handle is a funnel that can be held with one hand while the other pours, which is the entire design brief. The flexible spout is there because the filler neck is never where the container is.
